title: The World Remembers
reveal: Some marks are already learning to outlive their makers.
phases: The ground keeps what people do. Some marks may outlive the world that made them.
Paths, notes, and deaths overlap here, as though memory is learning to survive its owners.
You can read—and leave—the world’s memory. You no longer assume the world is its final keeper.

title: A Life Becomes Capable
reveal: A body and a lineage do not end in the same way.
phases: A life can grow in directions the body remembers. Some inheritances may be older than the body.
This life has begun to take a shape of its own, and its limits no longer feel entirely accidental.
Death ends a build, but not everything a life leaves behind. Something knows the difference between body and lineage.

title: Feast Before the Journey
reveal: Survival already behaves like a kind of accounting.
phases: Food can be stored intention. Survival already behaves like a kind of accounting.
A prepared body can do more than a merely fed one; it can borrow against tomorrow.
You have felt reserves become performance—and debt. Staying alive can be a yield of its own.

title: Stone Makes Promises
reveal: A world can be read as an inventory before it is understood as a home.
phases: Stone tells you what it wants to become. A deposit resembles a message left in matter.
You can read a deposit before you know its assay, and the pattern repeats too neatly to feel private.
Simple geology has opened into dirty chemistry. A world can be read as an expendable inventory.

title: Materials Have Temperaments
reveal: Some unfamiliar decisions feel as though they were catalogued before you made them.
phases: A material is a behaviour, not a tier. Old names cling to some temperaments.
Your tools have begun to carry a temperament; some choices feel strangely pre-catalogued.
You choose matter for the way it acts. You have stopped assuming yours were the first hands to sort it.

title: Motion Becomes Industry
reveal: A world can become a machine that earns while it survives.
phases: Rotation is labour waiting to be arranged. Every wheel resembles a promise to something beyond it.
One motion now performs work on your behalf. Your factory has begun keeping a second kind of time.
Your factory moves itself. A world can become a machine that earns for as long as it survives.

title: A Vessel Can Become a Place
reveal: Home need not remain attached to the ground beneath it.
phases: A boat can be built instead of crafted. A hull is the first argument that home need not stay put.
You have the beginnings of a place that floats; coastlines are becoming choices rather than walls.
The world now has coastlines instead of walls. Leaving and discarding it no longer mean the same thing.

title: Rails Turn Distance into Machinery
reveal: Direction itself can become infrastructure—and strategy.
phases: A railway is one machine stretched across distance. Its routes remember priorities.
Stations and signals make motion deliberate; the network begins to prefer some futures over others.
Distance has become part of your factory. Direction itself is now a strategic resource.

title: Pressure Changes Matter
reveal: Duration and severity may belong to the same equation.
phases: Pressure is a reagent. Sealed force keeps a private account.
You can contain forces ordinary crafting wastes; duration begins to matter as much as severity.
Matter changes behind sealed walls. The same equation could describe a world made dangerous on purpose.

title: Machines Can Remember
reveal: Some caches may be intended for worlds that will not return.
phases: Storage can become memory; memory can become action. Neither requires its operator to remain.
Your network has begun to know what it contains—and to notice what is absent.
Machines remember and decide for you. Some caches may have been made for worlds that would not return.

title: Doors Borrow Other Worlds
reveal: Temporary worlds are not the same thing as unreal ones.
phases: Some doors borrow another world and must give it back. The debt is real even when the room is temporary.
You found an aperture that spends charge instead of keys; elsewhere has become a consumable condition.
You crossed somewhere temporary and returned on purpose. Temporary worlds are not the same as unreal ones.

title: Flight Must Be Engineered
reveal: Another intelligence may inherit the same sky for entirely different reasons.
phases: Flight is a materials problem before it is freedom. The sky is a border designed by matter.
You can make lift but not yet trust it; every freedom reveals another logistics chain.
The sky has become engineered. Another intelligence might inherit it without inheriting your reasons.

title: An Army Walks Toward You
reveal: An approaching agenda does not owe you a fair encounter.
phases: An army can approach before it exists. Intention has direction.
Pressure gathers beyond the loaded horizon, and its route is not necessarily about you.
You watched a route become a raid. Strategic actors do not owe you a fight—or your survival.

title: Leave the Atmosphere
reveal: Arrival is not evidence that you were first.
phases: The atmosphere is a machine you can eventually leave. Other worlds may already be destinations.
Your industry manufactures survival beyond air; home is becoming a supply problem.
You made another world into a destination. Arrival is not evidence that you were first.

title: Blood Can Become Infrastructure
reveal: Another authority might call the same economy by another name.
phases: Life can be made into infrastructure. Sacrifice has a longer memory than flesh.
You built a place where sacrifice persists as power; the apparatus records cost without a witness.
Blood moves through systems larger than a spell. Another authority might call the same economy by another name.

title: Reality Has Grammar
phases: Reality has grammar. Grammar implies prior speakers.
You compose effects instead of finding them; some forbidden clauses look worn at the edges.
The language admits sentences the world resists. Resistance may be correction rather than refusal.

title: Spirits Honour Contracts
reveal: Shared laws do not require shared names—or shared authority.
phases: Not every power obeys the same request. Authorities may share laws without sharing names.
You found a place where one tradition answers; the answer implies expectations you did not author.
Pacts, spirits, cauldrons, and command are different authorities. Agreement is not proof of understanding.

title: A World Can Be Inherited
reveal: An ending may be a transfer rather than a conclusion.
phases: A world can be finished without being discarded. An ending may be a transfer rather than a conclusion.
You found the machine that asks what should survive. The question feels older than its builder.
This world is one generation in a longer inheritance. Beyond it, someone has already learned to cache what remains.
